digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown / snapshot cache cleanup
propositions: macOS CI basetemp cleanup fails with PermissionError when snapshot test modules leave read-only .rebar/run_snapshots trees beneath pytest tmp_path

production snapshot publication applies intentional 0444/0555 permissions via _chmod_readonly, but cleanup was owned only by module-local fixture in test_snapshot.py, leaving non-removable snapshots from other modules
shared pytest teardown fixture now centrally removes exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots below each test-owned tmp_path using snapshot._rmtree_writable, preserving production read-only contract
snapshot producers in any module are now covered by shared conftest.py autouse teardown; module-local fixture was removed to prevent duplicate/shadowed cleanup
